children: Silver climbed to around $66 an ounce on Friday, its highest level in more than a week, as falling oil prices eased concerns over persistent inflationary pressures.
Gains were limited by a stronger dollar, which remained supported after the US Federal Reserve raised rates by 25 bps on Wednesday and signaled further increases in the coming months.
Markets are now pricing in a nearly 60% chance of another rate hike next month.
The Bank of Japan also raised rates to a 31-year high and signaled that further tightening remains possible.
Meanwhile, Brent crude fell for a third consecutive session, as easing concerns over Saudi supply disruptions outweighed fears of a broader escalation of the Middle East conflict.

title: Silver Rises as Lower Oil Prices Ease Inflation Concerns
